title: Resultant force magnitude
description: Essential: The magnitude of the resultant tension T is correctly identified as mg.

title: Resultant force direction
description: Essential: The direction of the resultant tension T is correctly stated as vertically upward.

title: Tension T1 expression
description: Important: The expression for tension T1 in string AB is derived as mg/cos(α).

title: Tension T2 expression
description: Important: The expression for tension T2 in string BC is derived as mg tan(α).

title: Force equilibrium reasoning
description: Important: The solution correctly applies static equilibrium, stating the net vertical force from the tensions balances the ball's weight.

title: Free-body diagram setup
description: Optional: A correct free-body diagram for the ball is implied or explicitly described, showing all forces.

title: Incorrect force resolution
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly resolves tensions (e.g., swaps sin and cos for angle α) in the equilibrium equations.

title: Missing equilibrium condition
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student fails to state that the resultant tension T must equal the weight for vertical equilibrium.
